items.question: What is the minimum age to qualify for the Taqdeer package of ICP services for senior citizens in the UAE?
items.gold: Senior citizens aged 60 and above who are beneficiaries of the social security programme.
items.fact: Taqdeer package requires senior citizens aged 60 and above

items.question: How many pillars does the National Policy for Senior Emiratis include?
items.fact: National Policy for Senior Emiratis has seven pillars
